info.name: Rallye Auth 2A — web cookies + CSRF
info.description: Manual local development tests matching AuthController. See docs/authentication-2a.md. Enable cookie jar; allowlist localhost for scripts. Collection variables have no real secrets. Fill password/newPassword/resetNewPassword locally. Activation/reset tokens must be copied from local mailbox; never commit/export populated secrets. Run requests individually in numbered order, pausing to fill tokens. No Authorization or mobile headers: web cookie flow. password is updated after successful password change/reset. Error folder is optional and state-dependent. Administration 3b.1 is in folder 05; manual SQL bootstrap is required first. See docs/administration-3b1.md. No actual credentials are included.
